name: functions_region_coverage
semantic_differences: Offline runs use a builtin-provider fixture plan, not an AzureRM plan.
AzureRM exposes common metadata but not SDK-created age, synthetic access/encryption flags, or function Kind.
Live AzureRM queries the explicitly curated type set; native all-resource inventory can include additional provider types.
Function-app Kind filtering is unsupported by azurerm_resources; live output can include other Web sites.
